underlines.text: for jealousy had not yet made her desperate

reference.text: CONVINCED as Elizabeth now was that Miss Bingley’s dislike of her had originated in jealousy, she could not help feeling how very unwelcome her appearance at Pemberley must be to her, and was curious to know with how much civility on that lady’s side the acquaintance would now be renewed.

underlines.text: Miss Darcy, on her brother’s entrance, exerted herself much more to talk

reference.text: Miss Darcy looked as if she wished for courage enough to join in it; and sometimes did venture a short sentence, when there was least danger of its being heard.
